[Rogue Class Transfer]:
In order to become a Treasure Hunter, the Rogue must successfully complete three quests. The Trial of the Seeker can only be undertaken by a player of level 35 or above. This quest begins with Master Dufner of the Town of Giran. The Testimony of Trust can only be undertaken by a player oflevel 37 or above This quest begins by meeting High Priest Hollint of the Town of Oren. The Test of the Searcher can be undertaken by a player of level 39 or above. This quest begins with Master Luther of Hunters Village.
[The Class Master]:
Rather than the quests, from level 40 you may visit the Class Master in Giran, next to the Arena. Clear his short trial, alone in a private hall, and he grants your new class at once.
